ranked.headline: Computational tools standardize, align, and model spatial omics measurements
ranked.summary: Multi-platform spatial datasets from Xenium, CosMx, and Raman imaging demand standardized metrics, cross-platform integration, and interpretable models.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and reference-guided methods advance single-cell and spatial profiling
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and comparative reviews now test existing single-cell and spatial methods directly, shifting emphasis from new tools to measured performance.

ranked.headline: Deep models recover regulatory and chromatin structure from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Foundation-scale and multimodal architectures integrate scRNA-seq, spatial, CyTOF and chromatin data, including PanFoMa's 3.5M-cell pan-cancer benchmark.

ranked.headline: Phenotype-supervised models combine genotype, imaging, and multi-omic layers
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply phenotype supervision or mediation structure to decide how omic and imaging layers are combined.

ranked.headline: Reproducible workflows and curated references for microbial sequence profiling
ranked.summary: Expanding metagenomic catalogs such as VIRGO2 and FungiGutDB make standardized, reproducible analysis workflows essential for comparable results.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein binding, flexibility and mutation pathogenicity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark all-atom structure models and deep scorers against classical baselines for binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools package specialized omics and phylogenetic steps for wider use
ranked.summary: Early-December 2025 preprints and a published R/Bioconductor package describe open-source tools for omics, phylogenetic, pangenome, and cryoEM data handling.

ranked.headline: Knowledge-guided representation learning for omics and imaging prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair foundation models, graph networks and contrastive objectives with biological priors to improve omics-based prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational methods recover hidden genome structure from noisy sequencing data
ranked.summary: New tools infer active X chromosomes, virtual karyotypes, and chromatin contacts de novo from noisy or indirect genomic measurements.

ranked.headline: Few-label fitness prediction and leakage-controlled variant effect modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test how sequence and genomic models generalize under few labels, missing data, and held-out proteins.

ranked.headline: Duplication and genomic models infer human-specific regulatory architecture
ranked.summary: Genome-scale sequence, chromatin, and expression data now support inference of regulatory architecture across human, fly, and chicken genomes.

ranked.headline: Constraints guide optimization-based inference of single-cell lineage and identity
ranked.summary: Lineage, marker, and identity inference from single-cell data increasingly rely on explicit formal objectives that make inferred maps and cell identities…

ranked.headline: Genetic circuits as perceptrons: tunable thresholds and resource-competition robustness
ranked.summary: Resource competition and shared translational machinery are now being modeled directly as design constraints for genetic and CRISPR-based computing.

ranked.headline: Statistical inference of pathogen dynamics from surveillance and within-host data
ranked.summary: Scalable inference methods now let mechanistic pathogen models be fitted to large, sparse surveillance, wastewater, and viral load datasets.

ranked.headline: Compressed and alignment-free methods infer variants and repeat structure from reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply compressed indexes and alignment-free k-mer methods to read-level variant and tandem repeat detection across diverse data…

ranked.headline: Atom-level and motif-scaffolding methods now design enzyme active sites de novo
ranked.summary: Riff-Diff yields enzymes with near-native activity, and RFdiffusion2 scaffolds all 41 benchmark active sites from atom-level geometry.

ranked.headline: Controlled tests and uncertainty estimates probe molecular deep learning reliability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study test whether molecular ML predictions hold under controlled design choices, method selection, and uncertainty estimation.

ranked.headline: Graph and deep networks link genomic profiles to cancer detection and drug response
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair learned models with genomic and transcriptomic profiles for compact biomarker, panel, and drug-response prediction.

ranked.headline: Interpretable machine learning extracts dynamic brain and neurodegeneration biomarkers
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs interpretable model design with longitudinal and dynamic brain representations for biomarker extraction.

ranked.headline: Graph-based and probabilistic models resolve haplotypes from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Polyploid phasing gains explicit uncertainty quantification as read-based haplotype methods diversify into learning and integer programming.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and learned priors refine gene-level and multivariate association testing
ranked.summary: Recent association methods add functional annotations, learned shrinkage and closed-form estimators to weighting of genetic evidence across variants and genes.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised and generative models learn reusable biomedical representations
ranked.summary: Recent work applies foundation-model, generative, and imputation methods to imaging, cell segmentation, and pose data with missing or scarce labels.

ranked.headline: Multiscale simulations couple cardiac tissue remodeling to organ-scale function
ranked.summary: Linking tissue remodeling to organ function requires coupled multiscale models, and new geometry tools help make them practical to build.

ranked.headline: Learned models assign proteins to organelles and cells from MS proteomics data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies semi-supervised, neural, and model-based methods to proteomic localization, deconvolution, and single-cell quality control.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict TCR and MHC peptide binding and T cell immunogenicity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend deep sequence and chemical models to TCR-pMHC binding, MHC-peptide affinity, and T cell immunogenicity.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based taxonomic frameworks and plasmid-driven secretion system diversity
ranked.summary: Large metagenomic and genome databases now enable explicit identity thresholds and hierarchical identifiers for viral and bacterial taxonomy.

ranked.headline: Telomere-to-telomere assemblies of two Diptera resolve gaps and Y-linked duplications
ranked.summary: Telomere-to-telomere Drosophila and Bactrocera assemblies and a fungal mobile element toolkit extend reference genome resources for downstream analysis.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-aware tools resolve HLA linkage, local haplotypes and meiotic crossovers
ranked.summary: Haplotype-level methods are emerging to quantify linkage, define local variants and estimate recombination directly from genotype and SNP data.

ranked.headline: Environmental metagenomic and amplicon workflows enable microbiome monitoring at scale
ranked.summary: Large environmental metagenome atlases and FAIR, containerized amplicon pipelines now anchor long-term microbial monitoring.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and hashing tools for DNA sequence and metagenomic data
ranked.summary: Four 2025 tools address space, collision, and authentication challenges in DNA sequence, taxonomic indexing, and ancient metagenomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Inferring protein conformational ensembles from diffusion models, cryo-EM and B-factors
ranked.summary: Generative models and experimental observables are now being used to sample conformational ensembles rather than single protein structures.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models link backbone geometry to nucleic acid sequence and energetics
ranked.summary: Deep learning now maps atomic-level structure to nucleic acid sequences and per-residue energetics, enabling direct structure-conditioned design.

ranked.headline: Truth-anchored simulation benchmarks variant callers and long-read mapping parameters
ranked.summary: Simulators that embed known variants into real or long-read data now allow mapping and mosaic calling to be scored against exact ground truth.

ranked.headline: Learned models span drug discovery platforms, MS identification, and target profiling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication report ML systems for model governance, LC-MS/MS small-molecule identification, and compound-target profiling at scale.

ranked.headline: Detection, growth coupling and cell size reshape inferred stochastic kinetic rates
ranked.summary: Kinetic parameters inferred from single-cell expression data depend on detection efficiency, growth coupling and cell-size regulation.

ranked.headline: Neural mass models and higher-order measures assessed against brain dynamics
ranked.summary: Reviews of higher-order information measures and unified neural mass frameworks sharpen how model outputs are tested against neural and speech data.

ranked.headline: Scalable inference for stochastic reaction networks via delays and neural estimators
ranked.summary: Parameter inference for mechanistic stochastic models demands simulation and estimator methods that stay tractable and reliable.

ranked.headline: Stability and criticality constrain individual and large-scale neural network dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply Griffiths-phase, neural mass, and E-I stability frameworks to explain variability in brain criticality and network dynamics.

ranked.headline: Simplified community models fail under strong coupling; motifs enable coexistence
ranked.summary: Recent studies delineate regimes where simplified microbial community models fail and the structural features that sustain coexistence.
